guards.reason: Keep the donor RGBA image usage 0x7: ADY Skia rejects borrowed Vulkan textures without VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT (0x4).

changes.reason: Reuse the first handle-field clear to preload the OHOS native handle. The paired 64-bit store initializes the entire field instead.
Record whether the original VkFormat is UNDEFINED before setting handleTypes.
Select native 0x8000 only for VkFormat UNDEFINED. The existing W9=1 path is retained for RGB.
Write the zero-extended selected handle and its zero padding together.
Compute the original protected-image flag from W5 bit zero while NZCV carries the format comparison.
Replace the redundant second zero store at SP+0x60 with the original protected TST to restore NZCV.
